0132 AND 0136 ARE READY FOR YOUR REVIEW, one commit each, 0136 stacked on 0132. Paths are under my scratchpad, /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Devbin/03c88122-8547-4528-bbc1-b59e05154dfd/scratchpad.

BASE AND ORDER. Both sit on ea5fdd1 plus your 0115 v2, scratch-committed. 0132 edits db.md, which 0115 adds, so 0115 has to land first. A SUGGESTION: land 0115 now rather than after 0123. The two share no file (checked: the patches' path lists are disjoint), and 0123 is held on the case-twin fix, so 0115 waiting on it holds 0132 and 0136 as well. It is your call.

0132: series0132/0001-0132-db-all-leaves-reset-out-a-mistyped-option-is-to.patch, sha256 05beb6106b26f7ec, 9 files, +235 -22 (build0132b at 0ea5787).
1. db all leaves reset out. devbin declares the default BESIDE the catalogue, _DEVBIN_BUILTIN_NOT_IN_ALL="db.reset" in lib/builtins, rather than as a column: one row in thirty-odd carries it, and a column would reshape every row and every positional reader, 0138's arm included. run_all reads it when config is silent, so in_all: true on reset brings it back, and db reset by name still runs. The skip report names reset on every db all.
2. lib/gatecmd's unknown-option refusal names the options offered here and help <cmd>, for every built-in gate command. It never says <cmd> all.
3. THE MIX_ENV=prod REFUSAL MOVED OUT OF lib/cmd/db. It is now a catalogue row, _DEVBIN_BUILTIN_REFUSALS ("db MIX_ENV prod <why>"), read by command_env_refusal in lib/resolve. bin/devbin asks it once, after command_active and before all, any option or the command line. A project handler is the one way past, as before. I chose a row over a db special case in the dispatcher (hv's no-special-cases rule) and over a new guard file under lib/cmd (a new vendored file type). Please push on that choice if you see a better one. lib/cmd/db keeps its comment and loses its check, so the check has one home.
Pages: db.md lines 10, 14, 18-24 (the refusal's new text), 34 and the config example, which now shows in_all: true bringing reset back. docs/configuration.md's in_all default reads "`true`, but `false` for `db reset`", and the table stays aligned.
EVIDENCE: 4 arms (data.bats 3, builtins.bats 1), all red on the code before the change, each for its reason: the override ran under prod with rc 0; db all ran ecto.reset; the typo named no options; the side tables did not exist. The 5 existing db arms are unchanged and green, the prod guard's among them. 10 mutants (mut0132.results), each applying and parsing, each killed by its arm: Z1 reset back in all, Z2 run_all ignoring the default, Z3 run_all ignoring config, Z4 the refusal saying <cmd> all again, Z5 naming no options, Z6 the dispatcher never asking, Z7 a handler refused too, Z8 the variable's name compared instead of its value, Z9 the row removed, Z10 any command getting the first row. shellcheck and the headless critic are clean. THE FULL SUITE, since bin/devbin and lib/resolve move: full0132.tap and .meta on build0132b, 1..1670. The count follows when it ends; landing waits for it.

0136: series0136/0001-0136-four-refusals-and-notes-name-their-true-cause-s.patch, sha256 e241986611311978, 7 files, +224 -4 (build0136 at aacabf7, on 0132).
1. command_unavailable_reason names options switched off by config. When all are, it says "every option it offers is switched off (enabled: false in <config>): <list>". When only some are, it names those and says the rest need a language this project does not declare. It asks only where the command's own language is spoken, so db in a project without elixir is still told about elixir first. A sixth arm holds that guard.
2. doctor's command-level shadow check asks _ships_behind_name (a command line, devbin's own handler, or a shipped option), so a filled name-only built-in such as precommit shadows nothing. test, upgrade and docs still do.
3. nonexec_handler_hint names a file at cmd/<name> without its executable bit, with the chmod, in both refusals: the exit-2 opt-in refusal and unrunnable_why's exit-3 name-only line.
4. help falls back to framework_option_summary for an option devbin owns, and a project's own option borrows nothing.
THIS TOUCHES 0128's GROUND lightly: _shadow_hits and command_unavailable_reason, not command_origin or _command_runnable. If your refactor wants _ships_behind_name in lib/resolve, move it.
EVIDENCE: 6 arms (optin 2, dispatch 2, doctor 1, help 1). Five are red on 0132's code, each for its reason. The sixth, the language guard, is green there by construction and is proved by M3. 10 mutants (mut0136.results), each applying and parsing, each killed by its arm: M1 no option ever named switched off, and M2 the two messages swapped (arms 1 and 3); M3 the language guard dropped (arm 4, the guard arm); M4 a non-executable handler never noticed, M5 the exit-3 refusal ignoring the hint, and M6 the exit-2 refusal ignoring it (arm 2); M7 every owned name shadowing again, and M8 none shadowing (arm 5, the second by its test control); M9 no fallback to devbin's summary, and M10 every blank summary borrowing --iex's (arm 6, the second by its fidelity control). shellcheck and the critic are clean. Its full suite runs on build0136, which holds 0132 and 0136 together, once full0132 ends.

ON YOUR APPROVAL I land 0132 and then 0136 after your 0115, each by land1.sh (git commit --only, the gate running, verified against its build commit).
